metadata.name: E. fimbriata oocyte and elemental composition data from Senegal
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of E. fimbriata (a marine bivalve) including oocyte dry mass, volume, lipids, proteins, calorific content, and elemental ratios (Ba/Ca, Sr/Ca, Zn/Ca) from samples collected at Foundiougne and Djifer locations in Senegal during 2014.

metadata.name: MITAPI 2015-2010 Difference Dataset
metadata.description: Dataset containing 12 NetCDF files with sector-specific differences between 2015 and 2010 for various categories including agriculture, energy, industry, power plants, production, residential/commercial, reference, shipping, waste, transport, traffic, and tropics.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta GPS Survey Data
metadata.description: GPS survey data from the Elwha River Delta containing latitude, longitude, elevation, and positioning accuracy metrics (HRMS, VRMS) collected on March 20, 2011.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta GPS Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing 106 GPS measurement records with latitude, longitude, elevation, date/time, horizontal RMS (HRMS), vertical RMS (VRMS), status, description, and event information collected at the Elwha River Delta on February 3, 2012.

metadata.name: Permafrost Extent and Ground Temperature Data for Antarctica
metadata.description: Dataset containing files with Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM), MAGT Standard Deviation (MAGTSTD), and Permafrost Probability Fraction (PERPROB) data for Antarctica, along with a thumbnail image.

metadata.name: Archive metadata for El_Bizri et al. 2019 publication
metadata.description: Dataset containing metadata about archive files including interviews, hunting registers, and catch-per-unit-effort records from a PANGAEA publication.

metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of Magallana hongkongensis physicochemical parameters
metadata.description: Laboratory measurements of various physicochemical and carbonate chemistry parameters for Magallana hongkongensis (Hong Kong oyster) samples. The data includes treatment conditions, area porosity, stiffness, hardness, density, volume measurements, pH, temperature, salinity, alkalinity, pCO2, carbonate species concentrations, and saturation states (Omega Cal, Omega Arg). All measurements were taken at a single location (Zhanjiang) on 2016-06-01.

metadata.name: Aerosol particle size distribution measurements at Neumayer station, 2018
metadata.description: Dataset containing aerosol particle size distribution (dN/dlogDp) measurements across 72 particle diameter channels ranging from 92.87 nm to 4845.51 nm, collected at Neumayer station in Antarctica throughout 2018.

metadata.name: Aerosol particle size distribution measurements at Neumayer station, Antarctica, 2019
metadata.description: Dataset containing aerosol particle size distribution measurements (dN/dlogDp) across 72 particle diameter bins ranging from 92.87 nm to 4845.51 nm, collected at Neumayer station in Antarctica during 2019. The measurements include temporal information, spatial coordinates (Latitude: -70.65, Longitude: -8.25), measurement height (7 m), and elevation (42 m).

metadata.name: Bohm-etal_2020 Data Files Catalog
metadata.description: Catalog of 12 data files associated with the Bohm-etal_2020 publication, including ECdata, plant performance data, weather data, and Noah-MP model simulation outputs from the Katharinentalerhof_Pforzheim location in the Kraichgau region.

metadata.name: Fish physiological and morphological measurements from Macapule Lagoon
metadata.description: Dataset containing physiological and morphological measurements of fish collected from Macapule Lagoon, including body mass, organ weights (gut, liver, stomach, heart), and biochemical parameters (HSI, K, GRI, TPRT, TG, cholesterol, glucose). Data collected across multiple seasons from December 2013 to August 2015.

metadata.name: Macapule Lagoon Water Quality Monitoring Data
metadata.description: Water quality measurements from Macapule Lagoon including temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrate, and phosphate concentrations measured at three zones during sampling events from December 2013 to June 2015.

metadata.name: Laboratory experiment on Mytilus galloprovincialis developmental stages under Control and High CO2 treatments
metadata.description: Dataset containing laboratory experiment data on Mytilus galloprovincialis (mollusk) developmental stages under different treatment conditions (Control and High CO2). Includes measurements of developmental stage percentages, oceanographic parameters (temperature, pH, salinity, DIC, CO2), and carbonate chemistry parameters.

metadata.name: PS87 Whale Sightings 2014
metadata.description: Dataset containing whale and dolphin sightings recorded during the PS87 research cruise in 2014. Each record includes observation date/time, geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude), species identification, certainty level of identification, number of individuals observed, and event identifier.

metadata.name: Balloon-borne meteorological measurements 2018-08-18
metadata.description: Meteorological data collected from a balloon flight including pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction, wind speed, and height measurements with geographic coordinates.

metadata.name: IODP Expedition 370 Core C0023A Sediment Sample Chemical Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing chemical analysis measurements (Alk peak area and Diols peak area) from 20 sediment samples collected during IODP Expedition 370 from Core C0023A. The data includes sample identifiers, depth measurements, and geographic location information. All samples were collected on 2016-09-17 at a single location.

metadata.name: Sensor binary files with UPC event data
metadata.description: Dataset containing sensor-related binary files (zip archives) with event information (UPC), geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation), and timestamps.

metadata.name: Birkeland Cruise - Fish and Siphonophores Video Recordings
metadata.description: Dataset containing video recordings of fish and siphonophores collected during the Birkeland Cruise, with associated metadata including file information, geographic coordinates, and collection timestamps.

metadata.name: Aerosol chemical composition from PS106/1-track expedition
metadata.description: Size-fractionated aerosol samples with chemical composition measurements of various ions collected during the PS106/1-track research cruise in 2017. The dataset includes measurements of Cl-, NO3-, SO4 2-, C2O4 2-, NO2-, Br-, F-, MSA, PO4 3-, Na+, NH4+, K+, and Mg2+ across 5 aerosol size ranges.

metadata.name: NunaWP4Mackenzie19 water stable isotope data
metadata.description: Stable isotope measurements (δ18O, δD) and excess deuterium (d xs) from water samples collected at various stations during the NunaWP4Mackenzie19 expedition in 2019. The dataset includes geographic coordinates, water depth, and sampling timestamps for 146 samples.

metadata.name: FDOM measurements from NunaWP4 Mackenzie 2019 expedition
metadata.description: Dataset containing Fluorescence Dissolved Organic Matter (FDOM) measurements including various peaks (A, C, M, T) and indices (FI, HI, BI) collected during the NunaWP4 Mackenzie 2019 expedition in the Arctic region. The data includes 146 samples with associated spatial coordinates, depth measurements, and temporal information.

metadata.name: Atmospheric water vapor isotope measurements at GVN station
metadata.description: Dataset containing atmospheric water vapor mixing ratio and stable isotope measurements (δ18O and δD) of water vapor collected at a fixed monitoring station (GVN). Measurements include water vapor mixing ratio with error estimates, oxygen-18 and deuterium isotope ratios with standard deviations, and deuterium excess (d xs) values. Data collected at 24m height above ground level at an elevation of 42m.

metadata.name: WDC06A ice core δ18O and Δ36 measurements
metadata.description: Ice core measurements from the WDC06A core including depth in ice/snow, gas age, oxygen isotope ratios (δ18O), and clumped isotope measurements (Δ36 and Δ36_2). Data collected from a single location in Antarctica.

metadata.name: SO268_043MUC German collector trial pre-impact sediment core geochemical data
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements from sediment core 20 collected at a single location during a German collector trial pre-impact study. The dataset contains elemental concentrations (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) and their relative errors at various sediment depths from a marine sediment core.

metadata.name: SO268 sediment core elemental composition - Belgian collector trial pre-impact
metadata.description: Elemental concentration measurements from sediment core samples collected during the Belgian collector trial pre-impact study. The dataset includes concentrations of various elements (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) and their associated relative errors, measured at different sediment depths from core 18 at station SO268_074MUC.

metadata.name: Sylt trawl survey data
metadata.description: Benthic trawl survey dataset containing 6 records collected in 2021. The data includes location coordinates (latitude/longitude), bathymetry depth, habitat type, Scomber scombrus (mackerel) total length and count measurements, salinity, and temperature data from trawl operations in the Sylt region.

metadata.name: ROV Quicklook Images from Survey PS122/5_61-35
metadata.description: Dataset containing 22 quicklook image files from an ROV (Remotely Operated Vehicle) survey event PS122/5_61-35 conducted on 2020-09-08. The images include ADCP (Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler) data, DVL, status, depth profiles with ECO, GPCTD, transmittance, and VIPER spectra visualizations.

metadata.name: Topographic GIS Files List
metadata.description: Dataset containing a list of GIS zip files and one XLSX file related to topographic high raw data

metadata.name: Manganese nodule samples with chemical composition data
metadata.description: Dataset containing manganese nodule samples with geographic coordinates, elevation, sediment depth, and chemical composition measurements (Mn, Fe, Ni, Co, Cu). Samples include whole nodules and nodules without cores, with descriptions of nodule morphology.

metadata.name: B. saida measurements from PS80 expedition
metadata.description: Dataset containing 86 preserved B. saida (chaetognath) specimens collected during the PS80 expedition. Includes morphological measurements (total length, standard length, wet mass), sex, condition index, degree of digestion, stomach mass, and stomach content mass. Sampling locations span Arctic regions with coordinates from 79.5°N to 89.1°N and -16.2°E to 130.9°E.

metadata.name: Total Phosphorus concentrations in Lake Constance, Fischbach-Uttwil
metadata.description: Dataset containing Total Phosphorus (TP) concentration measurements from Lake Constance at the Fischbach-Uttwil location. Measurements include concentrations averaged for July-September for the upper 20m of the water column and concentrations during the winter mixing period for the whole water column.

metadata.name: Geochemical composition of manganese nodules from event PLDS04MV-109BX
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical elemental composition data from manganese nodule samples collected during event PLDS04MV-109BX. The data includes concentrations of major and trace elements including rare earth elements (La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Tb, Ho, Yb, Lu), transition metals (Co, Ni, Cu, Zn), and other elements (Al, Si, Ca, Mn, Fe, Ba, Sc, Sb, Hf, Th, U) from different sample types (topside, underside, and bulk composition) of manganese nodules.

metadata.name: Sediment pore water chemistry from station M186_50-1GC
metadata.description: Dataset contains chemical measurements from sediment core samples including nutrient concentrations (nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate) and elemental compositions (chloride, sulfate, bromide, boron, manganese, calcium, iron, sodium, magnesium, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium) measured at various sediment depths from station M186_50-1GC.

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements from sediment core M186_54-1GC
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements from sediment pore water samples collected at station M186_54-1GC during event M186_54-1. The data includes concentrations of nutrients (NO3, NO2, NH4, PO4), major ions (Cl, SO4, Br), and trace elements (B, Mn, Ca, Fe, Na, Mg, Sr, Si, Ba, Li, K) measured at various sediment depths.

metadata.name: Limacina helicina laboratory experiment with carbonate chemistry measurements
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment data on Limacina helicina (pteropod) including measurements of temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC), total alkalinity (AT), pCO2, omega aragonite, omega calcite, and other carbonate chemistry parameters. The experiment includes control and incubation treatments with supersaturated and undersaturated conditions.

metadata.name: Baltic Sea pCO2 dataset
metadata.description: Dataset containing Baltic Sea pCO2 (partial pressure of carbon dioxide) data including climatology and long-term trend information.

metadata.name: Elemental composition of salps and pyrosomes from multiple oceanographic expeditions
metadata.description: Dataset containing elemental composition measurements (Carbon, Nitrogen, Hydrogen) and related parameters for salp and pyrosome species (tunicates) collected during various oceanographic expeditions. The data includes size, mass, tissue composition, C/N/H ratios, and other biological parameters for marine zooplankton samples from the Northeast Pacific, Hawaii, Southern Ocean, and Chatham Rise.

metadata.name: WA Cape Blossom 2021-06-25 7cm Aerial Survey Data
metadata.description: Aerial survey data from Cape Blossom, Alaska collected on June 25, 2021. Contains various geospatial products including RGB and CIR preview images, DSM previews, cloud-optimized GeoTIFF orthophotos, DSM tiles, hillshade imagery, point clouds (NIR and RGB), tile footprints in GeoJSON format, and processing information.

metadata.name: Ice/snow depth and density measurements from NM01_04_S01
metadata.description: Dataset containing 53 ice/snow samples with depth and density measurements collected on 2004-12-29 at a single location in Antarctica (latitude -70.65491, longitude -8.25491). Includes Depth ice/snow, Density ice, Depth desc, and associated image references.

metadata.name: PANGAEA Dataset 963863 - Physico-chemical, Particulate Matter, Temperature, and Hydrological Data
metadata.description: Metadata catalog for PANGAEA dataset 963863 containing physico-chemical data (in situ parameters, basic physicochemistry, nutrients, trace elements, and contaminants), particulate matter data (cations, trace elements, and mineralogy from X-Ray Diffraction), continuous temperature data at sampling sites, and hydrological data (modeled and measured mean daily discharge).

metadata.name: Porites sp. coral geochemical data from TIAREI-A1
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from a Porites sp. coral core (TIAREI-A1) with associated age, location, and elevation data.

metadata.name: Porites sp. geochemical data from TIAREI-3B
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from Porites coral samples collected at TIAREI-3B, including age data and location information.

metadata.name: Flade Isblink ice cap cryoconite and river sediment radionuclide measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of various radionuclides (137Cs, 210Pb, 214Pb, 241Am, 207Bi, 228Ac, 7Be, 40K, 238Pu, 239+240Pu, and their associated errors) from cryoconite and river sediment samples collected from the Flade Isblink ice cap area in Greenland during August 2022.

metadata.name: Santiurde_section geological samples
metadata.description: Dataset containing 19 geological samples from the Santiurde_section with mineral composition measurements including Quartz (Qz), Clay, Calcite (Cal), Gypsum (Gp), Dolomite (Dol), and Pyrite (Py) percentages, along with stratigraphic height, thickness, ratio, and location information.

metadata.name: Snow density measurements from DML21/22 expedition, Dronning Maud Land, Antarctica
metadata.description: Dataset containing snow density measurements taken at various depths in ice/snow during the DML21/22 expedition in Dronning Maud Land, Antarctica. The data includes geographic coordinates, depth intervals, timestamps, and corresponding snow density values.

metadata.name: Puchalski_AWS Daily Meteorological Observations 2018-2023
metadata.description: Daily meteorological observations from the Puchalski Automatic Weather Station, including solar radiation (SWD daily sum), temperature (minimum, mean, maximum), relative humidity (minimum, mean, maximum), and wind speed measurements.

metadata.name: Sediment samples from Kiwada Kazusa Chiba river sections
metadata.description: Dataset containing sediment sample data from river sections (Ono River and Yuki River) in the Kiwada, Kazusa, Chiba area, including sample IDs, section depths, ages, sedimentation rates, references, and geographic coordinates.

metadata.name: Paleomagnetic data from sediment cores
metadata.description: Dataset containing paleomagnetic measurements including magnetic declination, inclination, Virtual Geomagnetic Pole (VGP) coordinates, relative paleointensity (RPI), and age data from sediment cores.

metadata.name: ESIS_Uelzen - Remote sensing data for Uelzen, Germany
metadata.description: Dataset containing 6 band color composits and various indices (vegetation index, metabolism index, shape file attributes) for the Uelzen site in Germany, covering the period from 1984 to 2023. The data includes GeoTIFF files and shapefiles.

metadata.name: Aalen Remote Sensing Data Products
metadata.description: Dataset containing remote sensing data products for Aalen, Germany, including 6-band color composites, vegetation indices, and metabolism indices. Data is stored as GeoTIFF files and shapefiles, covering the period from 1984 to 2023.

metadata.name: Sediment core and rock geochemical data compilation
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements from sediment cores and rock samples, including sulfur isotope ratios (δ34S), methane content (CH4), calcium carbonate (CaCO3), total organic carbon (TOC), and other parameters. Data includes spatial coordinates, sample types, lithology, analytical methods, and collection dates from various sources.

metadata.name: Soil radiometric and age dating measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing soil samples with radiometric measurements (Uranium, Thorium, Potassium) and their errors, along with depth, elevation, and age dating information from sampling events NEP_1 and NEP_3.

metadata.name: Radiocarbon dating from archaeological sites in Borneo
metadata.description: Dataset containing radiocarbon ages from 42 archaeological sites across Borneo, including sites in Sabah and Sarawak (Malaysia) and Kalimantan provinces (Indonesia). The data includes uncalibrated and calibrated radiocarbon ages with standard deviations, lab labels, and references to published studies.

metadata.name: Geochemical oxide composition data from cruise PS101 samples
metadata.description: Dataset containing major element oxide compositions (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5) from geological samples collected during cruise PS101, with spatial coordinates and temporal information.

metadata.name: ODP Leg 112 Site 680A Sediment Core Geochemical Data
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements from sediment core samples collected at ODP Leg 112, Site 680A. The dataset includes elemental concentrations (Al, Ca, Fe, K, Mn, Na, P, Mo, U, N, S), total organic carbon (TOC), total carbon (TC), elemental ratios (Fe/Al, Mn/Al), enrichment factors (EF, EF_2), iron fractions (Feac, FeD, Femag, Fe Py, Fe react), excess Mo and U (Mo xs, U xs), and stable isotope measurements (δ15N, δ13C Corg, δ98Mo auth). Samples span the Pleistocene and Pliocene epochs with depth measurements from 0.72 to 6.26 meters.

metadata.name: P-wave travel time measurements from sediment core MSM44_362-1
metadata.description: Dataset containing 249 P-wave travel time measurements and related geophysical parameters (Vp-a, AGR, core diameter deviation) from sediment core MSM44_362-1. The data includes depth measurements, spatial coordinates, elevation, and timestamp information collected during event MSM44_362-1.

metadata.name: Sucha Woda Flood Boulder Diameter Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing boulder diameter measurements from 11 sites recorded during the Sucha Woda flood event on 2018-07-24. The data includes site identifiers, geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude), elevation, trunk counts, and 25 boulder diameter measurements per site.

metadata.name: ANT 1997/98 EMR Radar Profiles
metadata.description: Dataset containing 97 profile records from the ANT 1997/98 Antarctic expedition with EMR instrument data, radar product information (600 ns pulse and 60 ns pulse), and references to associated netCDF files, GIS (KML) files, and images.

metadata.name: X. umbellata pulsation laboratory experiment
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment measuring X. umbellata pulsation under different treatment conditions (Zooplankton, Control, DOC, Phytoplankton) across 12 tanks over 28 days of experiment.
metadata.temporal: daily measurements over 28 days of experiment

metadata.name: Uvigerina spp. stable isotope measurements from sediment core M78/1_181-3
metadata.description: Dataset containing stable isotope measurements (δ13C and δ18O) from Uvigerina spp. foraminifera in sediment core M78/1_181-3, including sediment depth, age, and associated metadata.

metadata.name: Sediment core 386-M0095B mineral composition data
metadata.description: Mineral composition percentages from sediment core samples collected at a single location. The dataset includes various mineral abundances (quartz, plagioclase, mica, chlorite, amphibole, and other minerals) measured at different depths in the core, along with sample identifiers, sediment depth, geographic coordinates, elevation, and collection date.

metadata.name: Geochemical measurements from sediment cores BH-II and BH-rec
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements from sediment core samples including Total Organic Carbon (TOC), Black Carbon (BC), Calcium Carbonate (CaCO3), pH, grain size distribution, magnetic susceptibility, trace metals (TP, Pb, Zn, Cu, S), and stable isotopes (δ13C, δ15N).

metadata.name: IODP Expedition 383 Sediment Core SST Data
metadata.description: Sediment core samples from IODP Expedition 383 (cores U1539A, U1539C, U1539D) containing depth, age, cluster, sea surface temperature (SST), SST standard deviation, geographic coordinates, elevation, and collection date/time measurements.

metadata.name: Arctic sediment core geochemical measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing 140 records of sediment core measurements from multiple locations in the Arctic region. Measurements include depth, age, sedimentation rate, accumulation rate, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), total nitrogen (TN), stable carbon and nitrogen isotopes (δ13C, δ15N), and grain size fractions (>63 µm, 63-2 µm, <2 µm).

metadata.name: Sediment core TOC and TIC measurements from GeoB16310-2
metadata.description: Dataset containing sediment core measurements including depth, total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), location coordinates, elevation, and sampling date/time from a single sampling event during cruise GeoB16310-2.

metadata.name: Sediment core TOC and TIC measurements from GeoB16310-3
metadata.description: Dataset containing sediment core measurements including depth, Total Organic Carbon (TOC), and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) from event GeoB16310-3 collected at a single location.

metadata.name: TOC and TIC measurements from sediment core GeoB16320-2
metadata.description: Dataset containing Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) measurements from sediment core samples collected at a single location during event GeoB16320-2.

metadata.name: Diatom assemblage data from sediment core AMK75-6150
metadata.description: Dataset containing diatom abundance measurements from a sediment core, including total diatom counts, warm/cold/ice-neritic/sea ice/sublittoral/freshwater/fossil diatom categories, and individual species abundances. Data collected from a single location at depth -3013m.

metadata.name: MOSAiC ice core chlorophyll and phaeophytin measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing 271 ice core samples collected during the MOSAiC campaign using an Ice Corer Kovacs Mark II device. The dataset includes measurements of Chlorophyll a (Chl a) and Phaeophytin (Phae) at various depths in ice/snow cores, along with location coordinates (latitude, longitude), depth information, section labels, and elevation data.

metadata.name: Sediment core radiometric dating data from LSMo22-1
metadata.description: Dataset contains sediment core measurements with 210Pb and 137Cs radiometric dating data from sampling event LSMo22-1. Includes depth intervals, supported and unsupported 210Pb concentrations with standard deviations, and 137Cs measurements.

metadata.name: 210Pb measurements from sediment core LTp22-1
metadata.description: Dataset containing 210Pb (Lead-210) radioisotope measurements from a sediment core, including supported and unsupported 210Pb values with standard deviations, depth intervals, and location metadata. The data was collected at a single location on 2022-04-08.

metadata.name: Sediment core geochemical measurements from LTp22-1
metadata.description: Dataset containing CLR-transformed elemental concentrations (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) and icoh/coh scatter values from sediment core samples collected at a single location. The data includes depth, age, and spatial coordinates for 41 samples.

metadata.name: M. balthica shell length and length-frequency data from Rönnebank, Baltic Sea, EMB320
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of Macoma balthica shell length and length-frequency data collected from Marine Protected Area and Reference area sites at Rönnebank in the Baltic Sea during expedition EMB320 in June 2023.

metadata.name: Lanaittu core sediment mineral composition data
metadata.description: Mineral composition percentages from 5 sediment samples taken from the Lanaittu core at a single location (Latitude: 40.2592, Longitude: 9.5014). The dataset includes various mineral types (HM, Transparent, Opaque, Turbid, Zrn, Tur, Rt, Grt, Ttn, Ep, Zoisite+clinozoisite, Cld, St, Glaucophane-crossite, Ky, And, Lws, Ves, Ol, Ant, Brk, Mnz, Xtm, Crn, Min unident), depth measurements, sample comments (grain size), and temporal information from 1994-01-01.
